source_text.body:
Spot YouTube comment leads and send to CRM
A Lindy agent watches new YouTube comments, picks out leads, enriches their information and sends them to Slack or a CRM.
Done with
LI
Lindy
What they did
The agent is built in Lindy's no-code builder, where you describe it in plain English and edit the generated flow on a visual canvas. It triggers on new comments on a YouTube video. It pulls out commenter names and handles, enriches the lead information, and pushes the result to Slack or a CRM.
How it went
The source gives no results or numbers for this agent. It only says the agent runs on its own once set up. It doesn't say how accurate the lead picking or enrichment is.
Worth knowing
Lindy bills by credits. The free tier gives 400 a month, and the source warns that agents stop when the cap is hit, so always-on lead capture may need Pro (about $49.99).
Try it yourself
with
Lindy
Copy prompt
Create an agent that checks new comments on my YouTube channel [channel name] every [interval]. Flag comments that look like potential leads for [my product or service], look up public details about each commenter, and post a summary to [Slack channel or CRM]. It's done when a test run shows correctly flagged leads landing in [destination]; ask me before creating any CRM records.
Original source: https://rimo.app/en/blogs/lindy-ai-review_en-US
